The test `['pandas.tests.tseries.offsets.test_yqm_offsets.test_apply_index()']` failed.
The test looks like:

```python
61 : def test_apply_index(cls, n):
62 :     offset = cls(n=n)
63 :     rng = pd.date_range(start="1/1/2000", periods=100000, freq="T")
64 :     ser = pd.Series(rng)
65 : 
66 :     res = rng + offset
67 :     assert res.freq is None  # not retained # error occurred here
```

It failed with the following error message and call stack:

```
E       AssertionError: assert <Minute> is None
E        +  where <Minute> = DatetimeIndex(['1999-11-01 00:00:00', '1999-11-01 00:01:00',\n               '1999-11-01 00:02:00', '1999-11-01 00:03:0...          '2000-02-01 10:38:00', '2000-02-01 10:39:00'],\n              dtype='datetime64[ns]', length=100000, freq='T').freq
>       assert res.freq is None  # not retained
pandas/tests/tseries/offsets/test_yqm_offsets.py:67: AssertionError
```

messages.content:
"You probably mean pandas.tests.tseries.offsets.test_yqm_offsets.test_apply_index(cls, n). It looks like:
```python
61 : def test_apply_index(cls, n):
62 :     offset = cls(n=n)
63 :     rng = pd.date_range(start="1/1/2000", periods=100000, freq="T")
64 :     ser = pd.Series(rng)
65 : 
66 :     res = rng + offset
67 :     assert res.freq is None  # not retained
68 :     res_v2 = offset.apply_index(rng)
69 :     assert (res == res_v2).all()
70 :     assert res[0] == rng[0] + offset
71 :     assert res[-1] == rng[-1] + offset
72 :     res2 = ser + offset
73 :     # apply_index is only for indexes, not series, so no res2_v2
74 :     assert res2.iloc[0] == ser.iloc[0] + offset
75 :     assert res2.iloc[-1] == ser.iloc[-1] + offset
```"

Conclusion: The test `pandas.tests.tseries.offsets.test_yqm_offsets.test_apply_index` checks whether the frequency of a DatetimeIndex is None after applying an Offset. However, the test failure indicates that the frequency of the DatetimeIndex remains as 'T', which suggests that the Offset is not being applied correctly to the index. Upon examining the code snippet for `test_apply_index`, we find that the assertion fails on line 67 because `res.freq` is still 'T' after adding the offset to the DatetimeIndex `rng`. This indicates that the `__add__` method of the Offset class is not being called correctly or at all when adding the offset to the index.
Suggestions for fixing the issue:

```
pandas.tseries.offsets.Offset.__add__(ArgType)
```
